verdict.rationale: Codegen supports Slack-based agent notifications, clarification requests, and progress reports (codegen-docs-2, codegen-docs-9), which could be accessed via a phone's Slack app, and agents present structured plans for review (codegen-docs-22). However there is no explicit mobile app, push-approval workflow, or documented mechanism for a PM to approve/reject agent decisions specifically from a phone while work continues. missing for 10: dedicated mobile/approval UI, explicit approve-in-place-of-agent-continuing workflow, evidence of PM-specific decision gating via phone.
